review.tagline: eve pipeline that turns GitHub or Linear issues into reviewed draft PRs
review.summary: An eve pipeline named Foreman: label an issue factory, @mention it, or delegate from Linear, and four agents (classifier, analyst, implementer, reviewer) each run in their own sandbox and end with a draft pull request on FACTORY_REPO. The reviewer sees only the pushed branch, a factory brain keeps notes about your repo between runs, and it deploys to Vercel with GitHub and Linear connectors. For teams piloting agent-written PRs with human merge.
review.audience: Teams piloting agent-written pull requests with human merge
strengths: Reviewer is isolated from the implementer; verdicts are made against the real diff
Six entry points including red-CI self-repair on factory branches only
Local dev TUI treats runs as untrusted; GitHub writes wait for approval
Separate docs site; CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md included
weaknesses: Tied to eve, Vercel Connect, Vercel Sandbox and Vercel Blob
No model provider named in the README; model access comes through the Vercel stack
First task fails if the GitHub App cannot reach FACTORY_REPO; the error surfaces late
